archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: ArcGIS
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
https://www.esri.com/en-us/arcgis/products/arcgis-online/overview
Suite of geographic information system (GIS) and location intelligence software developed by Esri. It provides organizations with tools to capture, manage, analyze, map, and visualize geospatial data to identify patterns, solve spatial problems, and support infrastructure planning.
There are a number of offerings (desktop, self hosted and online) - we need to know which varieties are in play.
They also used SIGNet (but that come means loads of different things and its marked for being retired). So the task here is to clean out geoSpatial and ensure ESRI meets all needs.
